title: Bar Code Labeling for Type D-1 Component and Type D-2 Composite Cassette Identification
scope: This practice describes the requirements for the generation of bar code labels for the automatic identification of type D-1 component and type D-2 composite cassettes. Dimensions and tolerances of the printed bar code symbols are specified. The symbol encoding, data structure, and formatting of the label information are also specified. Lastly, the label characteristics, size, orientation, and placement are specified. This practice includes both rear and side labels.
